annotations.title: Comparable sales near the property, scored

description:
Comparable completed sales for a valuation, beyond the property's own
    building: Land Registry sales of the nearest units (within 1 km, the 60
    months before `as_of`), widening from 250 m and 12 months until at least
    6 qualify. A sale qualifies when it is the same broad type (flats with
    flats, houses with houses, from the type recorded at the sale), within
    0.67-1.5x the subject's floor area when both are known, category A and
    not an anomaly. Category B, anomalous, new-build and out-of-band sales
    are returned with `flags`, never dropped: review contrary sales rather
    than ignoring them. Each sale: price, date, UPRN, address, distance,
    floor area, bedrooms, tenure, `qualifies`, `similarity` (score with
    distance, recency, size, type and bedrooms components). Floor area and
    bedrooms are the unit's CURRENT record, not as at the sale
    (`attributes_after_sale` flags a record dated after it). `selection`
    names the step used; `provenance` lists every step tried and the data
    watermark. Time-adjust prices with the published index before use.
    `as_of` YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD (default today); `limit` 1-60.
    UK only. Costs 10 credits (10p). Keyed on a UPRN, not an address: call `address_autocomplete` (free) to narrow, then `address_resolve` to get one.
